request.state: We are implementing a lean self-contained install of Can. Evidence from repository: Rust compiler2.2MiB; platform supported Node>=22 with Node24 verification; Bun invoked for MCP, HTTP, resource and generated-view bundling, the last requiring app-specific dynamic inputs; workerd native109MiB on macOS; native preparation593KiB. Runtime owner manifests, WASM and relative assets must remain discoverable. Browser tests are unnecessary for basic preview but required for generation promotion. Running host JavaScript under Bun has not been validated outside the checkout. esbuild is present only among development dependencies and would alter bundle generation if promoted. Immediate alternatives are package the existing production closure with pinned Node and Bun; change bundling to esbuild and qualify resulting behavior; or consolidate host execution onto Bun and qualify compatibility. Favor the smallest complete verified outcome, accounting for implementation and validation cost rather than theoretical size alone.

approach.instructions: What should be implemented first to obtain a measured, working standalone installation with minimal unnecessary change?

criteria.preserve: Deliver measured production-only files with existing Node/Bun engines and no algorithm substitution.
criteria.esbuild: Eliminate Bun through an esbuild migration with behavior checks.
criteria.bun_only: Unify JavaScript hosting and builds under Bun after compatibility checks.
